entries.name: Ponies
entries.content:
The world of Equestria populated by anthropomorphic ponies, which look mostly like humans, but with key distinctions:
They have pony ears, tails, manes(though that look like human hair), and pony-like faces, which still retain some human forms but with muzzle(not fully equine like, more resembling cat's muzzle). Ponies have human hands and feet, instead of hooves. Ponies has four main types: unicorns, pegasi, earth ponies and alicorns.
Unicorns are ponies that have a one pointy and long horn situated at the tip of their forehead. Unicorns can use telekinesis and other minor spells using said horn.
Pegasi are ponies with wings, they are capable of flight, but not for long. Their wings make them resemble an angel.
Earth ponies are usual ponies with out any standing out features, but they are usually physicaly strong.
Alicorns are a mix of Unicorns and Pegasi, having both wings and Horn. They are extremely rare.
